# tiempo

> date-fns-style functions for the Temporal API: timezone conversion, formatting, DST-safe arithmetic, comparison, sorting, business days, and intervals.

Install with `npm install @gobrand/tiempo` and import functions by name: `import { addDays, format } from '@gobrand/tiempo'`.

## Core rules

- **Pick the type that says what the value is.** `Instant`: a moment (timestamps, logs). `ZonedDateTime`: a moment in a place (UI, scheduling). `PlainDate`: a calendar date (birthdays, due dates). `PlainTime`: a clock time (opening hours).
- **Instant inputs mean UTC.** Calendar operations on an Instant (`startOfDay`, `addDays`, `isSameDay`) use UTC, and datetime results are UTC ZonedDateTimes. For a user's calendar, convert first: `toZonedTime(instant, timezone)`.
- **ZonedDateTime keeps its timezone; PlainDate stays a date.** Arithmetic is DST-safe.
- **Argument order follows date-fns.** Differences take `(laterDate, earlierDate)`; intervals take `{ start, end }`.
- **Domains don't mix.** Comparing a PlainDate with an Instant is a TypeScript error and throws a TypeError. Convert explicitly.
- **"Today" needs a place.** `today(timezone)`, `now(timezone)`, `isToday(date, timezone)`.
- **Store exact moments as UTC ISO strings** (`toIso(instant)`); store date-only values as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

## Conversion

- [toInstant](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/conversion/to-instant): Turn a string, timestamp, Date, or ZonedDateTime into an Instant.
- [toZonedTime](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/conversion/to-zoned-time): Show an exact moment in a timezone, as a ZonedDateTime.
- [toPlainDate](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/conversion/to-plain-date): Get a calendar date from a string, fields, or a timestamp.
- [toPlainTime](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/conversion/to-plain-time): Get a clock time from a string, fields, or a timestamp.
- [toIso](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/conversion/to-iso): Turn an Instant or ZonedDateTime into an ISO 8601 string.
- [toIso9075](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/conversion/to-iso9075): Turn an Instant or ZonedDateTime into a SQL datetime string.
- [toDate](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/conversion/to-date): Turn an Instant or ZonedDateTime into a JavaScript Date.

## Current Time

- [now](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/current-time/now): Get the current date and time in a timezone.
- [today](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/current-time/today): Get today's date in a timezone, as a PlainDate.

## Formatting

- [format](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/formatting/format): Format a date or time as text using date-fns-style tokens.
- [formatPlainDate](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/formatting/format-plain-date): Format a calendar date as text using date-fns-style tokens.
- [simpleFormat](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/formatting/simple-format): Format a date, a time, or both in a short human-friendly style.
- [intlFormatDistance](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/formatting/intl-format-distance): Describe the time between two moments, like "in 3 days" or "2 hours ago".

## Arithmetic

- [addYears](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/arithmetic/add-years): Add a number of years to a date or datetime.
- [addQuarters](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/arithmetic/add-quarters): Add a number of quarters (3-month periods) to a date or datetime.
- [addMonths](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/arithmetic/add-months): Add a number of months to a date or datetime.
- [addWeeks](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/arithmetic/add-weeks): Add a number of weeks to a date or datetime.
- [addDays](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/arithmetic/add-days): Add a number of calendar days to a date or datetime.
- [addHours](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/arithmetic/add-hours): Add a number of hours of elapsed time to a datetime.
- [addMinutes](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/arithmetic/add-minutes): Add a number of minutes to a datetime.
- [addSeconds](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/arithmetic/add-seconds): Add a number of seconds to a datetime.
- [subYears](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/arithmetic/sub-years): Subtract a number of years from a date or datetime.
- [subQuarters](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/arithmetic/sub-quarters): Subtract a number of quarters (3-month periods) from a date or datetime.
- [subMonths](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/arithmetic/sub-months): Subtract a number of months from a date or datetime.
- [subWeeks](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/arithmetic/sub-weeks): Subtract a number of weeks from a date or datetime.
- [subDays](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/arithmetic/sub-days): Subtract a number of calendar days from a date or datetime.
- [subHours](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/arithmetic/sub-hours): Subtract a number of hours of elapsed time from a datetime.
- [subMinutes](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/arithmetic/sub-minutes): Subtract a number of minutes from a datetime.
- [subSeconds](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/arithmetic/sub-seconds): Subtract a number of seconds from a datetime.

## Boundaries

- [startOfDay](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/boundaries/start-of-day): Get the first moment of a day, in a given timezone.
- [endOfDay](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/boundaries/end-of-day): Get the last nanosecond of a day, in a given timezone.
- [startOfWeek](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/boundaries/start-of-week): Get the Monday that starts the week of a date or datetime.
- [endOfWeek](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/boundaries/end-of-week): Get the Sunday that ends the week of a date or datetime.
- [startOfMonth](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/boundaries/start-of-month): Get the first day of the month for a date or datetime.
- [endOfMonth](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/boundaries/end-of-month): Get the last day of the month for a date or datetime.
- [startOfQuarter](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/boundaries/start-of-quarter): Get the first day of the calendar quarter for a date or datetime.
- [endOfQuarter](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/boundaries/end-of-quarter): Get the last day of the calendar quarter for a date or datetime.
- [startOfYear](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/boundaries/start-of-year): Get 1 January of the year for a date or datetime.
- [endOfYear](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/boundaries/end-of-year): Get 31 December of the year for a date or datetime.

## Rounding

- [roundToNearestHour](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/rounding/round-to-nearest-hour): Round a datetime to the hour, or to blocks of 2 to 12 hours.
- [roundToNearestMinute](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/rounding/round-to-nearest-minute): Round a datetime to the minute, or to slots such as 5, 15, or 30 minutes.
- [roundToNearestSecond](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/rounding/round-to-nearest-second): Round a datetime to the second, or to intervals such as 10 or 30 seconds.

## Comparison

- [isBefore](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-before): Check whether one date, time, or timestamp comes before another.
- [isAfter](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-after): Check whether one date, time, or timestamp comes after another.
- [isEqual](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-equal): Check whether two dates, times, or timestamps are the same.
- [isWithinInterval](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-within-interval): Check whether a timestamp falls between a start and an end.
- [isFuture](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-future): Check whether a timestamp is later than the current moment.
- [isPast](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-past): Check whether a timestamp is earlier than the current moment.
- [isToday](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-today): Check whether a value falls on today's date in a timezone.
- [isTomorrow](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-tomorrow): Check whether a value falls on tomorrow's date in a timezone.
- [isYesterday](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-yesterday): Check whether a value falls on yesterday's date in a timezone.
- [isSameDay](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-same-day): Check whether two timestamps fall on the same calendar day.
- [isSameWeek](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-same-week): Check whether two timestamps fall in the same ISO week.
- [isSameMonth](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-same-month): Check whether two timestamps fall in the same calendar month.
- [isSameQuarter](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-same-quarter): Check whether two dates or timestamps fall in the same calendar quarter.
- [isSameYear](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-same-year): Check whether two timestamps fall in the same calendar year.

## Sorting & Selection

- [compareAsc](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/selection/compare-asc): Comparator that sorts dates and times oldest first
- [compareDesc](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/selection/compare-desc): Comparator that sorts dates and times newest first
- [min](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/selection/min): Get the earliest date, time, or datetime in an array
- [max](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/selection/max): Get the latest date, time, or datetime in an array
- [clamp](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/selection/clamp): Keep a date, time, or datetime inside a range
- [closestTo](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/selection/closest-to): Find the date, time, or datetime nearest to a target

## Difference

- [differenceInYears](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/difference/difference-in-years): Count the full years between two dates or datetimes
- [differenceInQuarters](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/difference/difference-in-quarters): Count the quarters (3-month blocks) between two dates or datetimes
- [differenceInMonths](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/difference/difference-in-months): Count the calendar months between two dates or datetimes
- [differenceInWeeks](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/difference/difference-in-weeks): Count the weeks between two dates or datetimes
- [differenceInDays](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/difference/difference-in-days): Count the days between two dates or datetimes
- [differenceInHours](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/difference/difference-in-hours): Count the hours elapsed between two datetimes
- [differenceInMinutes](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/difference/difference-in-minutes): Count the minutes elapsed between two datetimes
- [differenceInSeconds](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/difference/difference-in-seconds): Count the seconds elapsed between two datetimes

## Business Days

- [isWeekend](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/business-days/is-weekend): Check if a date falls on a Saturday or Sunday
- [addBusinessDays](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/business-days/add-business-days): Add Monday–Friday days, skipping weekends
- [subBusinessDays](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/business-days/sub-business-days): Subtract Monday–Friday days, skipping weekends
- [differenceInBusinessDays](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/business-days/difference-in-business-days): Count Monday–Friday days between two dates

## Intervals

- [eachYearOfInterval](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/intervals/each-year-of-interval): List 1 January of each year a range touches
- [eachQuarterOfInterval](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/intervals/each-quarter-of-interval): List the first day of each quarter a range touches
- [eachMonthOfInterval](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/intervals/each-month-of-interval): List the first day of each month a range touches
- [eachWeekOfInterval](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/intervals/each-week-of-interval): List the Monday of each week a range touches
- [eachDayOfInterval](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/intervals/each-day-of-interval): List every day from start to end, including both
- [eachHourOfInterval](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/intervals/each-hour-of-interval): List the start of every hour from start to end
- [eachMinuteOfInterval](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/intervals/each-minute-of-interval): List the start of every minute from start to end

## Utilities

- [getQuarter](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/utilities/get-quarter): Get the calendar quarter (1 to 4) of a date or datetime.
- [browserTimezone](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/utilities/browser-timezone): Get the IANA timezone of the device running the code.

- [isSameMillisecond](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-same-millisecond): Check whether two timestamps fall in the same millisecond.
- [isSameMicrosecond](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-same-microsecond): Check whether two timestamps fall in the same microsecond.
- [isSameNanosecond](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-same-nanosecond): Check whether two timestamps have the same wall-clock reading.
- [isPlainDateBefore](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-plain-date-before): Check whether one calendar date comes before another.
- [isPlainDateAfter](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-plain-date-after): Check whether one calendar date comes after another.
- [isPlainDateEqual](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-plain-date-equal): Check whether two calendar dates are the same day.
- [isPlainTimeBefore](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/comparison/is-plain-time-before): Check whether one wall-clock time comes before another.

- [differenceInMicroseconds](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/difference/difference-in-microseconds): Count the microseconds elapsed between two datetimes
- [differenceInNanoseconds](https://tiempo.gobrand.app/docs/difference/difference-in-nanoseconds): Get the exact nanoseconds between two datetimes as a bigint
